tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~140bp (Jul 14 est., +16bp from Jun 30's 124bp) as Trump's Hormuz blockade and 20% cargo tribute order, plus a third consecutive night of US strikes on Iran, fully reverse the Jun 22-23 roadmap compression trend. Reload protection to 60-70% - do not wait for a re-test of the 115-120bp target, that thesis is dead. Stress scenario (25%): iTraxx settles 150-180bp. Tail scenario (65%): spikes to 200-230bp on sustained blockade. Only reduce on a confirmed blockade lift or Iran accepting terms.
instruments: iTraxx Asia ex-Japan IG CDS 5Y (reload to 60-70%)
Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (add)

tradeIdeas.title: JKM-TTF Spread - Stop Out; Europe Outbids Asia for Gulf Cargoes
tradeIdeas.rationale: TTF €50.43/MWh (Jul 13, OilPrice.com/Yahoo Finance, +16.7% vs Jul 8) surged sharply while JKM $18.75/MMBtu (Jul 13, LNGPriceIndex.com) fell -5.1% over the same window - the opposite of the Jun 30 'JKM supply-lag premium' thesis. Qatar's extended force majeure into Aug-Sept (JOGMEC) is now pushing Europe to aggressively rebid for the same disrupted Gulf-adjacent cargoes Asia was counting on, compressing the spread that supported a long-JKM/short-TTF position. Close the spread; both markers face continued upside risk on the Hormuz blockade, but the relative-value edge that justified the JKM leg is gone. Re-evaluate once Qatar force majeure scope clarifies.
instruments: Asia LNG spot cargo purchase via intermediary (hold off)

tradeIdeas.title: Close ASEAN Banks Long / Hold Energy Underweight - Compression Trade Invalidated
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~140bp (Jul 14 est., +16bp from Jun 30's 124bp) - the risk-on compression that supported the banks long has reversed. ASEAN Banks ~212 idx est. (-1.0% on the day) still shows a green zscore but has lost its credit-spread tailwind. ASEAN Energy ~110 idx est. (+3.0% on the day, tracking the Brent rally) remains deeply depressed vs its 90-day baseline (zscore -3.77) - the war-zone/disruption discount still dominates the crude price benefit. Close the banks long / energy underweight divergence trade; re-enter only once credit spreads resume compressing.
instruments: ASEAN Energy basket underweight (hold, do not add)

tradeIdeas.title: Reverse Long PHP/IDR - Energy Import Bill Pressure Returns
tradeIdeas.rationale: USD/PHP ~55.72 est. (Jul 14) sits above the Jun 30 55.00 entry and never reached the 54.50-55.00 take-profit zone. USD/IDR ~15,785 est. (Jul 14; -0.35% on the day but above the Jun 30 15,650 entry) similarly stalled. The Jun 30 'deal de-escalation EM FX recovery' thesis is invalidated: Trump's Hormuz blockade and 20% cargo tribute reignite energy-import-bill pressure on both economies as Brent trades at $84.70, +15% from the Jun 30 $73.62 entry level. Close the long PHP/IDR position; consider reversing to short PHP/IDR (long USD) given tail risk at 65%. Re-enter long PHP/IDR only on a confirmed blockade lift.
instruments: ASEAN EM FX basket (reduce long vs USD)
